headline: Gold edges up today; silver flat, down over the last 12 days
summary: Gold 24K moved ₹1 today (about 0.01%), essentially unchanged, but is up 2.65% (₹377) over the last 7 days and 2.3% (₹328) across the 12 days in our history. Silver per kg was up ₹100 today and over the last week, while it is down 4.5% (₹9,900) since 26 October, when it was at its highest in our history. Possible drivers include the US dollar and rupee movements, import duty, and festive or wedding buying, though the data does not confirm any single cause.
outlook: Prices are close to today's levels, so there is no urgency either way; compare the making charges and GST at your jeweller before buying.
